title: Other Compute Services
description: Compare EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, Batch, and Lightsail to understand which service fits each workload.

data.text: EC2 is powerful but requires you to manage the operating system, networking, and scaling. AWS offers higher-level compute services that handle more of the undifferentiated heavy lifting for you. Elastic Beanstalk, Batch, and Lightsail each solve different problems.

Elastic Beanstalk is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) that makes it easy to deploy and manage applications. You upload your code, and Elastic Beanstalk automatically handles capacity provisioning, load balancing, scaling, and health monitoring. You retain full control over the underlying AWS resources but do not need to manage them directly.

AWS Batch is a fully managed service for running batch computing workloads. You define the job, the compute environment, and the queue. AWS Batch provisions the optimal quantity and type of compute resources based on the volume and requirements of your jobs. It is ideal for large-scale processing like financial modeling or video rendering.

Lightsail is the simplest way to get started on AWS. It provides virtual private servers with a fixed monthly price, bundled storage, data transfer, and static IP addresses. Lightsail is designed for small projects, blogs, simple websites, and developers who want predictable pricing.

data.title: AWS Compute Services at a Glance

cards.title: Amazon EC2
cards.description: Resizable virtual servers. Maximum flexibility and control.
pros: Full control over OS and settings

cards.title: Elastic Beanstalk
cards.description: Deploy applications without managing infrastructure. Best for web apps.

cards.title: AWS Batch
cards.description: Run batch workloads at any scale. Best for data processing.

cards.title: Lightsail

terms.definition: A PaaS for deploying and scaling web applications and services without managing infrastructure.
A managed service for running batch computing workloads at any scale.
An easy-to-use virtual private server service with predictable monthly pricing.

data.title: Deploy a Sample App with Elastic Beanstalk CLI
data.content: Elastic Beanstalk can deploy a simple web application in minutes using the EB CLI.
data.code:
# Initialize Elastic Beanstalk application
mkdir my-webapp && cd my-webapp
eb init -p python-3.11 my-webapp

# Create an environment and deploy
eb create my-webapp-env

# View application URL
eb status

# Deploy updated code
eb deploy

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Elastic Beanstalk is the easiest way to deploy web applications
AWS Batch is ideal for large-scale batch processing
Lightsail provides simple, predictable pricing for small projects
Choose the service that matches your workload and operational needs
